english.title: In making a para 6 Sch 1 statement made a false declaration under para 5 Sch 1
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) with respect to a declaration made under paragraph 5(1) of Schedule 1 to the Civil Partnership Act 2004, namely that each of the proposed civil partners

(A)_[has specified their affinal relationship,]_
(B)_[has declared that the younger of them has not at any time before reaching 18 been a child of the family in relation to the other,]_
(C)_[has specified their affinal relationship and has declared that the younger of them has not at any time before reaching 18 been a child of the family in relation to the other,]_

made a statement mentioned in paragraph 6 of Schedule 1 to the Civil Partnership Act 2004, alleging that a declaration under paragraph 5 of that Schedule was false in a material particular, and you knew that statement to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE MATERIAL PARTICULAR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(1)(d) and 80(3) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004.
